theme_strategy.description: A high-visibility, technical command-center look optimized for IPTV resellers. Sharp lines, deep dark backgrounds, and vibrant accents to highlight critical data like active tests and WhatsApp connection status.

headings.usage: Dashboard titles, metric numbers, landing page heroes. Tightly tracked (tracking-tight).

body.usage: Data tables, forms, sidebar navigation, standard text. Geometrically precise and highly legible for data.

mono.usage: MAC addresses, command templates, API logs, and WhatsApp technical statuses.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Tactile minimalism. Use flat dark backgrounds (`bg-[#121212]`) with a crisp 1px border (`border-white/10`). Avoid soft heavy shadows. For elevated elements like dropdowns, use Glassmorphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/80 border-white/10`).
visual_enhancers.whatsapp_qr: CRITICAL: The WhatsApp QR code container MUST have a pure white background with padding (`bg-white p-4 rounded-xl`) to ensure phone cameras can scan it effectively, regardless of the dark theme.
visual_enhancers.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp slightly-rounded (`rounded-md`) buttons. Primary buttons use `bg-brand-primary text-white hover:bg-brand-primary_hover transition-colors`. No excessive gradients.
visual_enhancers.badges: For Client Status (Ativo, Vencido) or System Type (IPTV, P2P, Hybrid), use solid or tinted badges (e.g., `bg-success_bg text-success border border-success/20`).
visual_enhancers.payment_card: For the InfinitePay checkout block on `/pay/{customer_id}`, use 'The Tracing Beam' or a subtle glow effect behind the selected plan to drive conversion.

admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (left) + Main content area. Mobile: Hamburger to slide-out drawer.
admin_dashboard.dashboard_grid: Bento-style High Density Grid. Metrics: `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4`. Recent activity/tables: `col-span-full xl:col-span-3`.
admin_dashboard.spacing: Dense inside cards (`p-4` or `p-6`), generous between sections (`gap-6` or `gap-8`).

public_landing_teste.structure: Single column, deeply centered. `max-w-lg mx-auto pt-24 px-4`.
public_landing_teste.hero: Bold H1 heading, tech-focused background, clean and trustworthy form asking for Name, WhatsApp, System Type (IPTV/P2P/Hybrid).

public_payment.structure: Split screen or centered focused container. Show Plan options (1m, 3m, 6m, 12m) as large toggleable cards, followed by InfinitePay action.

components.forms: Use Shadcn UI Inputs and Selects. Ensure high contrast focus states (`focus:ring-2 focus:ring-brand-primary`).
components.tables: Shadcn Table. Flat, dense. Use mono font for MAC addresses. Align numbers to the right, text to the left.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs to switch between System Types (IPTV, P2P, Hybrid) in the client list.
components.modals: Shadcn Dialog for 'Create Manual Test' and 'WhatsApp Chat History'. Overlay must be dark (`bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-sm`).

motion.interactions: Hover states on rows: `hover:bg-white/[0.02] transition-colors`. Button clicks: subtle scale down (`active:scale-95`).
motion.page_transitions: Fade in and slight slide up (`framer-motion`: `initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 10 }} animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}`).

libraries.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (best for dense tech dashboards, use Duotone or Regular weights)
libraries.charts: recharts (for displaying daily created tests and revenue metrics in the dashboard)
libraries.3d_and_effects: react-tsparticles for the `/teste` public landing page to add a subtle drifting node/tech background, avoiding blank empty spaces.

public_background.description: Abstract blue lines and dots background. Use as a low-opacity fixed background layer on the public `/teste` and `/pay` routes.

default_avatar.description: Default avatar for clients in the dashboard.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Text must be perfectly readable against #050505 and #121212 surfaces.
accessibility.testing_attributes: All inputs, buttons, and row actions MUST have `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid='btn-create-test'`, `data-testid='input-whatsapp'`).
accessibility.transparency_rule: CRITICAL: Do not use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, tooltips, or modals.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
Do not apply global `transition: all` as it breaks specific transform animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing for structural layout gaps, but keep data tables dense.
Do not center-align everything; keep forms and data tables strictly left-aligned.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons. Use Phosphor Icons instead.
Use `sonner` for all toast notifications (success, error, payment updates).
For the dashboard layout, ensure the sidebar is fixed or sticky, and the main content scrolls independently.
Ensure all text is in Portuguese as requested by the problem statement.
